title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — October 30, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 311 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Nice and quiet out there. ☀️💫

A broad coronal-hole-like region and several modest bright regions are visible, while the coronagraph appears routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
